parameters.jsCode: const value = $input.first().json; const result = value.result ?? value; const action = result.reason === 'existing_profile_in_use' ? 'The existing Pinterest Personal browser profile is already open. Bring that window forward; do not launch another browser or profile.' : result.status === 'review_required' && result.accountReadiness?.some(item => item.identityVerified === false) ? 'Reach manifest ready for review, but this account has no calibrated identity selector. Do not publish until the existing account profile has been checked and its UI controls are configured.' : result.status === 'review_required' ? 'Pinterest Personal Reach manifest ready. Review the exact pack, every ordered image, copy, account, destination and visibility; approve this digest only after review.' : result.status === 'awaiting_owner_login' ? 'Finish login in the existing Pinterest Personal browser profile, then run plan again. No new browser profile is needed.' : result.status === 'caught_up' && result.progress?.some(item => item.unresolved > 0) ? 'No eligible Pinterest Personal Reach packs. Review unresolved or unsupported deliveries in the report before trying again.' : result.status === 'caught_up' || result.status === 'completed' || result.status === 'synchronized' ? 'Read the Pinterest Personal Reach progress and receipt report. This workflow never switches accounts.' : 'Inspect the stop reason and reconcile the exact Pinterest Personal Reach item before any retry.'; return [{ json: { ...value, action } }];
